scope: Single-variable source capture controls. No model or aligned appearance reference.

follow_up_plan.scope: Follow-up chosen after observing all six initial source controls. No model selection or fitting.
follow_up_plan.hypothesis: A 120-update hold consistently restores the observed shelf/building/marking detail in these two source paths.
follow_up_plan.acceptance: Inspect every view and compare each repeat with the first camera-hold run. All three must retain the observed structure and markings. Numerical differences measure source variation, not appearance fidelity or a GPU fence. Preserve failures.
